change_summary: Preserve transport-owned package freshness evidence, add one bounded visible-facts retry when a Host omits those headers, persist content-free freshness observations for real usage statistics, and keep package-manager, Marketplace, organization, and fresh-session update authorities separate.

canonical_skill.note: The canonical Skill keeps transport metadata primary and retries freshness exactly once with already-visible package constants only after the server reports missing evidence.

server_contract.note: The server advertises release 1.7.97 and contract 2026-10-04.1, returns missing-evidence and one-retry fields, keeps transport headers authoritative, and persists bounded freshness observations without host content or paths.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to release 1.7.97 and collaboration contract 2026-10-04.1.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.43 recommends only the API-reviewed exact version when npm proves it installable and reports channel/default-alias drift without selecting an unreviewed build.

help_center.note: Existing Help remains source-aware and does not promise silent cross-host updates; detailed operator behavior is carried by the bundled setup and distribution runbook.

package_setup.note: The session hook reports release 1.7.97 and contract 2026-10-04.1 and names the same bounded retry after an explicit missing-evidence result.

harness_and_mainline.note: Harness and release mainlines now treat package-manager defaults as public projections and define the reviewed-installable intersection plus bounded missing-transport fallback.

external_marketplaces.note: Publishing release 1.7.97 and deployed-package discovery remain separate release-owned gates; repository changes do not claim Marketplace availability.

public_release_assets.note: The canonical exporter will regenerate both immutable archives from synchronized 1.7.97 Skill, manifests, references, and hook source.

release_evidence.note: Focused tests cover channel-ahead review, stale default alias, aligned admin transfer, missing transport evidence, transport priority, content-free telemetry, release projection repair, and synchronized package manifests.
